## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build` pass locally
- [ ] Follows the [project standards](docs/standards/README.md) (folder / coding / component / naming)
- [ ] New UI checked at mobile, tablet and desktop widths, in light **and** dark
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or real credentials added (including in tests/fixtures)
- [ ] New dependencies are justified in the description; `pnpm audit` clean
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour, setup or env vars changed
